stemMd: Four talks, P, Q, R and S, occupy four successive slots. P is before Q, R is immediately after Q, and S is not first. Which talk must be first?
explanationMd: Q cannot be first because P precedes it, and R cannot be first because Q immediately precedes it. S is explicitly excluded. Only P remains, and a valid order such as P,Q,R,S confirms feasibility.

distractorRationale.a: The conditions explicitly exclude S from first.
distractorRationale.c: S is not permitted to be first.
